intro: Lady Katrana Prestor is a noblewoman of Stormwind and one of the most influential voices at court. With King Varian missing, she stands beside the boy-king Anduin and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep as a trusted advisor.

p: Lady Prestor arrived at court some years ago and quickly rose to become one of its most trusted figures. The nobles of Stormwind seek her favor, and her counsel shapes many of the decisions made in the young king's name while Highlord Bolvar Fordragon rules as regent. Petitioners who come to Stormwind Keep asking for soldiers or aid often find that her opinion carries as much weight as the regent's.
